name: Screen Time
author: nabdalla
description: Daily screen time per app in your Omarchy bar: sees what runs inside terminals, names Steam games, folds browsers and web apps. The popup has a donut chart, a 52-week trend you can page through, insights and an optional daily goal. Fully local: nothing leaves your machine.

schema.label: Ignored apps
schema.description: Comma-separated app names that are never counted.

schema.label: Custom app names
schema.description: app=Name pairs, comma-separated, e.g. zen=Browser, foot=Terminal.
